title: Varindzi va Ntanga
intro: Ejarateni leri tlhumeke, vaaki va endle xihlambanyo lexi xiximekaka. Kambe ku tiyimisela ka vona ku ringiwile loko ku navela ka Xikwembu ku nghenelela, ku hundzula vunyingi bya vona byi va tiko leri nga riki na nchumu.
clues: Hi katekisiwile hi ntanga wo tala, kambe hi sungule ku tikukumuxa.
Hi endle pulani yo tshovela handle ko avelana ni swisiwana.
Hi suke nimixo swinene, hi tiyiseka eka rhengu ra hina.
Kambe loko hi fika, hi kume leswaku ntanga wa hina wu onhiwile hi vusiku byin’we.
Hi xi xiyile xihoxo xa hina kutani hi sungula ku solana.
Eku heteleleni hi hundzukile, kambe dyondzo yi dyondziwe endzhaku ka nkarhi swinene.

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Moya lowukulu lowu a wu tsuvula mirhi

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Va hundzukile kambe va lahlekeriwe hi ntanga wa vona
outcome.answer: Va hundzukile kambe va lahlekeriwe hi ntanga wa vona

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
